title: "Appendix 5: Report Sheet for Lab Incidents"
format: html

[← Back to Biological Safety](../biological-safety.qmd)


A template of the report sheet for incidents is available for [download](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BBUZSVqYkssfwdyOqsLk8zhMobOHM5KXDR3Ka4Nytfo/edit?usp=sharing). It has to be filled and shared with the responsible persons after every lab incident, even a minor one.

The report sheet contains the following fields:

| Field                         | Content |
| ----------------------------- | ------- |
| Name(s)                       | persons involved |
| Date / time                   | |
| Organism / sample             | e.g., *Ascaris suum* eggs, batch number |
| Sequence of events            | what happened, where, which equipment |
| Damage of property            | no / yes, which; if yes, also report to SSHE ([property damage](https://ethz.ch/staffnet/en/service/safety-security-health-environment/safety-security-health-environment/sachschaden.html)) |
| Injuries                      | no / yes, which; if yes, also report to SSHE ([accident or medical event](https://ethz.ch/staffnet/en/service/safety-security-health-environment/safety-security-health-environment/notfall-was-tun/unfall-oder-medizinisches-ereignis.html)) |
| Immediate measures / actions  | decontamination, first aid, medical consultation |
| For information to            | BSO, project leader, SSHE-BSO |

All the reports are stored by the BSO and GSR in digital form in an ordered manner for at least five years. Incidents involving Group 2 organisms are also entered in the list of employees ([Appendix 2](02_list_of_employees_SAMV.qmd)).
